verdicts.reason: A: the logo panel keeps the sun and the SOLSTICE wordmark readable, and the CTA is a clear, prominent button. But the four-line headline, body copy and legal text are jammed into a 90px-tall strip, the legal text is unreadably small and stacked right under the body copy, and the orange divider is left floating at the bottom. B is worse: the logo shrinks to a barely visible speck, the CTA button is tiny and outweighed by an oversized 'Ships late June' that wraps onto two lines (inverted hierarchy), and the body copy and legal text are just as cramped.
